prompt: Create ONE finished unlettered cover scene on an ordinary light-wood kitchen table. At center foreground sits a simple pale teal ceramic bowl filled with cooked WHITE RICE: soft distinct elongated plump grains, no chopsticks, utensils or food toppings. Beside the bowl lies ONE small dry rice panicle, botanically based on reference upper-right panicle: open branching stalks with individual golden husked grains. Behind the bowl is ONE plain unbranded cream paper rice bag with a folded closed top and no printing. Quiet pale kitchen wall background, no people or extra objects. Only bowl, dry panicle and bag on one physical table; no diagrams or panels. Accurate small panicle relative to bowl and bag; all fully visible with broad safe margins. Preserve the bold flat outlined cartoon style; rice grains are simple shapes, no realistic fine texture. Clean bold dark outlines and flat natural colors, simple restrained cel shading; no fine texture, grain, painted effects, photorealism or 3D. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. All important subjects inside central 70% with wide margins at least 140px. No text, labels, numbers, logos, flags or symbols.

visualReview.note: Direct native inspection: one teal bowl of plump cooked white grains, one cream unprinted bag and one small dry branching panicle on same table; no text/extra objects; broad margins.
visualReview.limits: Individual image inspection recorded from the exact-hash production inspection; independent sequence, reader, scorecards and audio reviewed separately.
